study.question: Does user/context embedding ownership need to change after successful item and selector isolation, and can auxiliary-private context learning protect click quality without sacrificing auxiliary predictions? Observed limitation: g3-r0022-selector_disabled achieves click AUC 0.6662458901, while auxiliary-detached/live score donors give 0.6662326738/0.6662078240 and the self donor 0.6662276914; these single-seed results do not support selector complementarity. The earlier g3-r0003 factorial shows that context-gradient blocking helped when item gradients were joint (0.6591802749 versus 0.6583679241) but hurt when items were blocked (0.6599038839 versus 0.6601633627), an interaction about -0.00107183. Later private items restored auxiliary quality; g3-r0021-aux_primary_live was worse for click than its detached counterpart (0.6648664056 versus 0.6661173479). The present source still shares user/context embeddings between all four tower losses. These observations motivate a conditional ownership test, not a presumption that more isolation wins.
study.hypothesis: Auxiliary labels describe broader category/brand activity and can favor a different user/context geometry from impression clicking once their item and selector paths are private. A single auxiliary-private context group may allow auxiliary context learning without directly rewriting the primary context. This is a provisional mechanism hypothesis with counterevidence: the earlier item-blocked context contrast favored sharing. An equally admissible outcome is that context gradients remain complementary and private context is unnecessary. No claim of novelty or improvement is made. Review of the trajectory index found all listed trials successful in execution; negative scientific branches, including learned auxiliary value transfer (g3-r0006-learned_aux_transfer) and auxiliary route donation (g3-r0012-redistrib_aux_detached), remain evidence against indiscriminate transfer. The latest declared INFNet-inspired usage is provenance only: round 22 did not demonstrate a benefit of auxiliary selector transfer.

study.proposed_difference: Create one auxiliary context copy after all inherited initialization, preserving original RNG draws and original primary parameters. Deepcopy the context layers and encoders together so aliases within that group survive without aliasing the original. Compute both original and copied context in every cell. Click always reads the original. Auxiliary towers use shared/private context crossed with live/detached context-input derivatives. Private/detached is a fixed initialized categorical-context control; shared/detached continues observing the click-updated original context. All three auxiliaries share the same copy in private cells. Selector transfer stays disabled and the legacy block_aux_context_gradient stays false; the new explicit factors alone control the intervention. The shared/live cell should reproduce the parent function and used gradients. Active capacity and backward cost intentionally differ despite matching allocations; this study does not claim a new network family.
predictions: At initialization all four new cells produce the inherited outputs for identical inputs, including arbitrary label order, and the shared/live cell matches used-parameter derivatives. The copies have independent storage and do not change inherited initialization/RNG state.

If current context gradients are harmful, both shared/detached and private/live should improve click AUC over shared/live. A click delta of at least +0.0002 is a predeclared continuation threshold, not a significance test; smaller differences are inconclusive pending repeatability/cost evidence.

If private context learning preserves useful auxiliary learning, private/live should beat private/detached on auxiliary mean AUC, with auxiliary mean AUC no worse than shared/live by more than 0.001. Report all individual AUC/Logloss tradeoffs even when the mean passes this tolerance.

Private/live, private/detached and shared/detached have no direct auxiliary gradient into primary context. Their click differences can reflect global clipping and other indirect training interactions; such differences are not evidence of complementary private-to-primary context transfer.

Declare the space-by-gradient interaction as (AUC_private_live - AUC_private_detached) - (AUC_shared_live - AUC_shared_detached). Report it descriptively alongside taskwise metrics, measured parameters, training/wall/GPU cost, peak memory, examples and inference throughput/p50/p95 latency; do not equate one seed with repeated support.

Use predeclared history bins empty, 1-16, 17-64, >64 as diagnostics with sample/positive/negative counts. Empty-history support is only 6444 samples / 427 positives; no isolated slice win selects a model. Other slices require training-defined bins and a host-authorized interface; do not invent unavailable diagnostics.
falsifiers: A shared/live reproduction mismatch, label/padding dependence, nonfinite outputs/loss/gradients or an unexpected derivative path fails the implementation gate; this is not scientific evidence for or against context interference.

Shared/live matching or beating both isolated alternatives on click contradicts the predicted harm of shared context gradients in this architecture. Retain this null/negative result and the earlier sharing benefit rather than extending the isolation claim.

Private/live failing to improve auxiliary mean over its frozen-copy control undermines the claim that learned private context provides auxiliary value. An auxiliary decline beyond 0.001 versus shared/live fails the proposed quality-preservation criterion.

A private/live gain without a shared/detached gain does not establish context gradient interference; representation trajectories and dense clipping are alternative explanations requiring a discriminating follow-up.

A small click difference comparable to seed variation, or insufficient reserve for admissible repetition, leaves mechanism support preliminary. No withheld result is requested or used to choose variants.
alternative_explanations: User/context information may remain beneficial to share even when item and selector gradients interfere; the earlier context-by-item interaction already supports architecture-dependent effects.

Different context trajectories alter auxiliary towers, private item learning and global dense clipping rather than providing a direct signal to click. Learning-rate/optimizer geometry is not held equal merely by allocating equal tables.

Private copies increase independent useful degrees of freedom and can help auxiliary fitting through capacity. The frozen copy and detached shared controls distinguish some effects but do not match effective trained capacity; no pure capacity-free claim is justified.

Short single-pass training may underfit a private context table, or sparse context support can induce overfitting. This experiment is bounded by the frozen recipe; an unsuccessful implementation does not refute all task-conditioned representation designs.

Single-seed adaptive validation search, sparse positives, repeated users and inherited official_offline visibility limit generalization and causal interpretation. No production point-in-time validity, significance, independent replication or original-method priority is established.

cost_plan.estimate_ref: g3-r0022-selector_disabled: 595.374953985 s wall, 548.466686904 s training, 10,357,012,992 peak GPU bytes; g3-r0021 variants cost 581-622 s wall. Estimate 720 s per context cell, 2880 s total; conservative hard-cap envelope 4 * 1203.368969355 = 4813.48 s. Initial resolved remaining budget was 117473.103959 s; preparation and all host checks/runs consume the same fixed deadline.
cost_plan.attribution_reserve: Reserve 10000 s for host-authorized paired repetition of the consequential candidate/closest controls and necessary discriminating follow-up, including failed checks and diagnostics. Initial suite uses only frozen seed 20262027; never override seed/epochs in model CONFIG. Target three paired seeds only when the later host repetition interface authorizes them; otherwise explicitly retain single-seed limitations. Estimate about 7,532,000 extra context weights from 31,793,216 original embedding parameters minus 24,261,216 item/action weights; about 63,939,643 total / 63,586,432 embedding / 353,211 dense parameters if context is entirely the pinned categorical group. Host counting, aliases and encoders are authoritative. No quadratic history activation is added; measure actual cost rather than claim equal compute.
cost_plan.assessment_reserve: Reserve at least 6000 s for a later frozen comparison/repetition and closed assessment suite, plus reporting. No held-out call is part of this proposal. Freeze source/config/checkpoint hashes, selected candidate, baseline, closest controls, ablations, paired seeds and authorized assessment commands before any withheld scoring; closed outcomes never enter open memory.
cost_plan.stop_rule: Do not train locally or install packages. Host must gate initial equality, copied storage, context-only gradient recipients, valid task order, empty/zero-length/padded histories and current-action invariance, finite FP32/BF16 forward/backward, optimizer registration and actual resource feasibility. Respect the fixed 1203.368969355 s per-trial cap and the unchanged global deadline. Stop if any hard limit, integrity failure or lack of a useful admissible experiment applies; preserve failed receipts and charged costs. Do not resubmit an assessment with unknown execution state or silently duplicate a failed call. If estimated suite plus reserves no longer fits, reduce future experiments without altering protocol; exhausted budget is not success.
